function.mechanism: Provides acidity/pH adjustment and buffering; tartrate anions can complex metal ions (sequestration/synergy), supporting stability and flavor profile.

adi.basis: Group ADI for L(+)-tartaric acid-tartrates (E334-337, E354), expressed as tartaric acid; EFSA 2020 opinion.

efsa.key_finding: EFSA set a group ADI of 240 mg/kg bw/day for L(+)-tartaric acid-tartrates; refined exposure did not exceed this ADI for E334-337/E354. ADI does not apply to D(-), DL, or meso tartrates.

adi.basis: Group ADI range 0-30 mg/kg bw for L(+)-tartaric acid and sodium/potassium/potassium-sodium salts; latest listed evaluation year 2017.

concerns.summary: EFSA notes nephropathy findings in studies involving DL/meso-related tartrate material at high doses in rats; EFSA group ADI is restricted to L(+)-forms and explicitly excludes D(-)/DL/meso tartrates.

In EFSA combined high-end exposure modelling (including other tartaric-releasing additives and natural occurrence), toddler P95 could exceed ADI, but EFSA judged this as likely overestimation rather than a confirmed safety concern.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA reported no indication of genotoxic potential for tartaric acid and sodium/potassium salts.
EFSA reported no carcinogenicity indication in chronic rat study with monosodium L(+)-tartrate at highest tested dose.
EFSA refined non-brand-loyal exposure estimates for E334-337/E354 did not exceed the EFSA group ADI.
JECFA maintained group ADI range (0-30 mg/kg bw) at latest listed evaluation in 2017 for L(+)-form group context.

adi_exceedance.notes: For E334-337/E354 alone, EFSA refined exposure was below ADI. A combined scenario including other tartaric-acid sources showed toddler P95 above ADI, but EFSA considered this overestimated and not indicative of health concern.

risk_assessment.rationale: Major regulators (EFSA, FDA, JECFA) permit use with ADI/cGMP controls, and EFSA found no major hazard signals for authorized L(+)-forms at typical use levels. Remaining caveats are stereoisomer specificity, specification/impurity controls, and conservative high-end combined exposure modelling.
